description: This file defines the 'Screencast' class and 'FrameThrottler' class, managing screencast recording, video capture, frame throttling, and related utilities within the Playwright core server.

classes.name: Screencast
classes.description: Manages screencast recording, frame throttling, and video capture for a page.

classes.name: FrameThrottler
classes.description: Handles throttling of frame acknowledgments to control frame rate during tracing.

methods.name: stopFrameThrottler
methods.description: Stops the frame throttler, releasing resources.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Sets screencast options such as width, height, and quality.

methods.name: throttleFrameAck
methods.description: Acknowledges a frame with throttling logic applied.

methods.name: temporarilyDisableThrottling
methods.description: Recharges the frame throttler, resetting its budget.

methods.name: launchVideoRecorder
methods.description: Initializes video recording if enabled in the context options.

methods.name: startVideoRecording
methods.description: Starts recording video with specified options.

methods.name: stopVideoRecording
methods.description: Stops video recording and finalizes the video artifact.

methods.name: _setOptions
methods.description: Internal method to start or stop screencast based on options.

methods.name: _startScreencast
methods.description: Internal method to initiate screencast streaming.

methods.name: _stopScreencast
methods.description: Internal method to stop screencast streaming.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of resources used by FrameThrottler.

methods.name: recharge
methods.description: Resets the throttler's budget and sends all pending acknowledgments.

methods.name: ack
methods.description: Acknowledges a frame, considering throttling state.
